name: Mihai Popescu
bio:
Mihai's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by late-night broadcasts and a knack for tinkering with anything mechanical. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Bucharest, he quickly immersed himself in the world of Formula racing, starting as a junior engineer and rapidly advancing through the ranks. His analytical mind and proactive approach to problem-solving earned him the respect of his peers and superiors alike.

Mihai believes that the key to success lies in a holistic understanding of the car and its interaction with the track. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail, but also for his ability to step back and see the big picture, ensuring that every component works in harmony. His flexible nature allows him to adapt quickly to changing circumstances, a crucial asset in the fast-paced world of motorsport. He's developing a reputation for spotting and nurturing young engineering talent within his team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Mihai is a slender man with a focused gaze and an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to work late at night, claiming he's most productive when the garage is quiet.
